summary: After a late count flips the lead, the one behind phones the winner and posts a short note that running was an honor.
realLife: A council president candidate conceded after counting went on for days, called the leader, and posted that it was an honor to run; the winner said they would meet for coffee.
sources: The Spokesman-Review, concession after the late count, Nov. 14, 2019: https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2019/nov/14/cindy-wendle-concedes-city-council-president-race-
inGame: close count read over several days; both candidates' ties

turns.turn: The call is cordial and a meeting is set
The call is short and the post is the only public word
turns.writesBack: no meeting and a brief note
